color.note: Three world themes share one set of semantic roles. Wilderness is the default and first theme; Fantasy and Sci-fi redefine the same roles. Components only ever reference roles, never raw values.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Deepest ground: behind docked panels on narrow screens, letterbox, loading. Never a panel fill.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panel body fill (Inventory, Crafting, In View, World Agent). Default ground for `ink`, `ink-muted` and `ink-faint`.

tokens.name: surface-glass
tokens.usage: Floating HUD fill over the world: survival card, time bar, action picker, launchers. Pair with a backdrop blur of 8px.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Rows, inputs and tabs inside a panel; the resting fill of circular launchers and quick actions.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, tabs, launchers and quiet buttons.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected row, active tab, pressed control. Always paired with a second cue (border in `accent` or a check), never fill alone.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and around panels. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, launchers) — holds 3:1 against `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-glass`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface token. Warm ivory in Wilderness.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: row subtitles, captions, meta labels. 4.5:1+ on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-hover` and `surface-glass`.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text and the unavailable state (grayed actions, locked recipes): 4.5:1 on `surface`, `surface-glass` and `surface-raised`. Never on `surface-selected`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Muted sage (Wilderness) — active launcher ring, selected-row edge, progress fill, links. Text-safe on every surface.

tokens.name: accent-quiet
tokens.usage: Tinted wash behind an active launcher, a selected tab or a contextual quick action.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Restrained antique gold. The one primary action per view (Invent, Send), the focus of a discovery, the in-game time. Use sparingly — at most one gold element per panel.

tokens.name: highlight-quiet
tokens.usage: Wash behind primary buttons and a newly discovered item.

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid `highlight` fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 3:1+ on every surface and on the world.

tokens.name: health
tokens.usage: Health meter fill and its icon. Warm clay rose.

tokens.name: food
tokens.usage: Food meter fill and its icon. Wheat.

tokens.name: energy
tokens.usage: Energy meter fill and its icon. Moonlight.

tokens.name: meter-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled part of every meter and progress bar.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Critical meters (≤20%), destructive confirmations, failed actions. Always with a word or icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger-quiet
tokens.usage: Wash behind a danger button on hover and a failed-action notice. Keeps destructive controls in their own hue instead of turning green.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `danger` fill (the pressed danger button).

tokens.name: world-text
tokens.usage: Status text, work labels and hover labels drawn over the world. Always with the tight `world-halo` shadow (0 1px 2px), never a background plate.

tokens.name: world-halo
tokens.usage: Colour of the single tight text shadow (0 1px 2px, via --world-text-shadow in bundle.css) under `world-text`. Barely visible on dark ground; keeps white text legible on sand, snow and water glare.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the world behind a narrow-screen sheet or a modal invention dialog.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The game name in the top-left mark only. Set in capitals with 0.16em tracking.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: Panel titles (Inventory, Crafting, In View, World Agent) and dialog titles. One per panel.

styles.name: entity-title
styles.usage: The name at the top of a detail view — a person, creature, object or recipe.

styles.name: count
styles.usage: Stack counts and big numerals in inventory rows. Tabular lining numerals.

styles.name: narrative
styles.usage: Story voice: empty states, journal entries, discovery moments, the world agent's descriptive passages. Short — two or three lines.

styles.name: narrative-italic
styles.usage: Quoted speech from characters and whispered lore lines.
styles.sample: “The reeds bend toward the old ford.”

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default reading text: chat messages, descriptions, tooltips' explanations.
styles.sample: Describe a tool you need. If its method fits what this world can do, it may become a recipe.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Row titles, button labels, tab labels, menu items.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Row subtitles and secondary facts (Gatherable, Cold, Watching the clearing).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Footnotes, helper text, hint lines (Click to walk · Scroll to zoom). The smallest permitted size.
styles.sample: Conversations are saved in this browser.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section labels inside panels (KNOWN RECIPES). Capitals, 0.14em tracking. Never for sentences.

styles.name: world-status
styles.usage: Status notices and work labels floating over the world, in `world-text` with the halo.

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: In-game clock and speed readouts in the time bar. Tabular.

spacing.note: 4px base. Components use these steps only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap in small controls; meter bar to its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; tab gap; row internal gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding; gap between launchers.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel inner padding (sides); gap between docked panels.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel header top padding; gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: HUD inset from the screen edge.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Separates the panel dock from the launcher rail.

radius.note: Wilderness values. The theme layer in bundle.css remaps --radius-sm/md/lg for Fantasy (tighter, 4/6/6) and Sci-fi (2/2/2 + chamfered panel corners).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags, keyboard hints, meter bars.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Rows, inputs, tabs, menu items (Wilderness).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Floating HUD cards: survival card, time bar, action picker.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels (Wilderness). Fantasy and Sci-fi override this in the theme layer.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Launchers, quick actions, pills, progress bar ends.

size.note: Icon and control sizes. Scale the whole HUD with --ui-scale rather than editing these.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Inline icons in meta lines, tag icons, close glyphs.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Row icons, button icons, menu items.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Launchers and quick actions.

tokens.name: icon-xl
tokens.usage: Empty-state and detail-view hero symbol.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Close / back / tab-close buttons (hit area never below 32px).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menu rows.

tokens.name: launcher
tokens.usage: Circular left/right launchers and bottom quick actions.

tokens.name: panel-width
tokens.usage: Default panel width on wide screens; panels never shrink below 296px.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Every panel and the survival card: lifts it off the world without a glow.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Action picker, tooltips, launchers — small floating things.

duration.note: All motion collapses to 0ms (opacity-only cross-fades) under prefers-reduced-motion or the in-game Reduce motion setting.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Hover colour, focus ring, completion — completion labels vanish immediately.

tokens.name: duration-quick
tokens.usage: Hover label fade, tooltip exit, button press.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Panel open/close, tab switch, row selection.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Panel dock reflow, Back/detail slide, discovery reveal.

tokens.name: duration-hover-intent
tokens.usage: Delay before a detailed action explanation appears.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Things entering: panels, menus, notices.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Things leaving.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Reflow and progress fill.

tokens.name: z-world-label
tokens.usage: Status text and work labels over the world.

tokens.name: z-hud
tokens.usage: Meters, time bar, launchers, quick actions.

tokens.name: z-panel
tokens.usage: Docked panels.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Action picker and tooltips.

tokens.name: z-sheet
tokens.usage: Narrow-screen bottom sheet and its scrim.
